Idaho Springs Loop

Road Book · checked Nov 23, 2026 · not saved yet

⌂ CatalogBeforeD1Help

A half-day loop from Boulder, 90 miles. Nothing found closed on it, but one road, Gross Dam, can close at short notice: check it last thing.

Using it offline

  • Nothing to download: opening this page with a signal saves it. When the top says ✔ saved for offline, it's on this phone: page, maps, strips, GPX files and the weather.
  • Then open the same address without a signal. Easiest: in Chrome, ⋮ then Add to Home screen (iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen).
  • The night before, open it with a signal: that gets the latest version and a fresh forecast for the dates you set below.
  • It stays until you clear the browser's data. Try it once in airplane mode before you leave.

Weather and what to wear

At the hour you'd be at each place. Within 16 days: a forecast. Further out: the last five years.

Go or no-go

Your ticks stay on this device.

As of Nov 23, 2026: not a promise for your ride date.

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 76-81

    Gross Dam Road

    Denver Water's own road, open to the public when its dam work allows. No closure notice was found on Nov 23, 2026, and no promise of one for your date either: it has closed at night and for rockfall. Closed? Stay on CO 72 to CO 93, 18 mi, paved.

    Denver Water

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 46-47

    I-70 at Floyd Hill, exits 241 to 243

    A mile and a half of interstate in a construction zone. Full closures so far are at night (last one Nov 2026), with traffic sent down East Idaho Springs Road (CR 314) instead.

    CDOT, Nov 9, 2026; live: cotrip.org

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 29-32

    Upper Apex Valley Road

    The roughest, least-traveled piece; TerraTrack's data isn't sure of its class. No closure found. Skip it if wet: stay on CO 119 to Black Hawk and climb through Central City.

    Gilpin County

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 15-19

    South Beaver Creek Road

    Gilpin County approved rebuilding 4 miles with recycled asphalt (Nov 2025) and was looking for the money; no start date found. Soft spots when wet.

    Gilpin County

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 1, mile 0-90

    Wildfires

    No fire since 2019 on this line. The 2021 Marshall and 2022 NCAR fires are near Boulder, off the line.

    NIFC perimeters, checked against the line

  • ✔ No issue found · Whole trip

    Fees and permits

    None found for riding through. Gap Road runs beside Golden Gate Canyon State Park: stopping to use the park needs a pass.

    Colorado Parks and Wildlife

If it goes wrong

  • Emergency 911. Patchy signal in Gilpin County and around Gross Reservoir.
  • Clinic in Idaho Springs (map data); hospitals in Boulder.
  • Mid-June sunset is about 8:30 pm.

Desk-planned; distances can be off by a few tenths. Hours change: call. Not legal advice; the Forest Service's MVUM is the legal document. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; relief: USGS The National Map; fire perimeters: NIFC.
